summary: The PR addresses the issue of trailing slashes causing errors when using django-admin startapp, but there are some concerns about the implementation.

issues.description: The change modifies the variable used in the validate_name call from `target` to `top_dir`, which may not be the intended behavior. This could lead to different validation logic being applied.

There are no additional tests added to specifically cover the case where a trailing slash is included in the directory name. While the existing tests pass, more targeted tests should be added to ensure robustness.
